metadata.description: ML engineering and MLOps plugins for Claude Code: data pipelines, training, fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, RAG, and vector databases.

plugins.name: data-labeling
plugins.description: Data labeling: annotation guidelines, platforms, inter-annotator agreement, active learning, weak supervision, and label error detection.

plugins.name: data-pipelines
plugins.description: ML data pipelines: Apache Beam, Spark, dbt, orchestration, streaming features, validation, and backfills.

plugins.name: data-versioning
plugins.description: Data versioning: DVC, Delta Lake, lineage, dataset cards, and reproducible dataset splits.

plugins.name: distributed-training
plugins.description: Distributed training: DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed ZeRO, model parallelism, mixed precision, and multi-node debugging.

plugins.name: experiment-tracking
plugins.description: Experiment tracking: MLflow, Weights & Biases, Neptune, ClearML, hyperparameter search, and run organization.

plugins.name: feature-engineering
plugins.description: Feature engineering: feature stores, transformations, selection, time-series features, leakage checks, and drift.

plugins.name: gpu-optimization
plugins.description: GPU optimization: profiling, memory management, torch.compile, Flash Attention, Triton kernels, and quantization.

plugins.name: llm-fine-tuning
plugins.description: LLM fine-tuning: LoRA and QLoRA, instruction datasets, DPO and PPO alignment, adapter merging, and evaluation.

plugins.name: ml-testing
plugins.description: ML testing: data quality tests, model unit tests, behavioral tests, and performance regression gates.

plugins.name: mlflow-integration
plugins.description: MLflow: tracking server, model signatures, Model Registry, projects, custom flavors, and serving.

plugins.name: model-deployment
plugins.description: Model deployment: ONNX export, BentoML, TorchServe, Triton, FastAPI serving, dynamic batching, and canary rollouts.

plugins.name: model-evaluation
plugins.description: Model evaluation: metrics with confidence intervals, calibration, sliced and fairness evaluation, and LLM output quality.

plugins.name: model-monitoring
plugins.description: Model monitoring: data and concept drift, performance estimation without labels, and alerting without alert fatigue.

plugins.name: model-registry
plugins.description: Model registry: versioning, staging gates, champion and challenger promotion, model cards, and CI/CD webhooks.

plugins.name: model-training
plugins.description: Model training: PyTorch Lightning and Hugging Face Trainer loops, LR schedules, gradient health, checkpoints, and early stopping.

plugins.name: prompt-engineering
plugins.description: Prompt engineering: prompting techniques, system prompts, structured output, injection defense, DSPy, and prompt versioning.

plugins.name: pytorch-patterns
plugins.description: PyTorch: custom datasets and DataLoaders, nn.Module design, model surgery, custom autograd, and profiling.

plugins.name: rag-architecture
plugins.description: Retrieval-augmented generation: chunking, embeddings, vector stores, hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounded generation, and evaluation.

plugins.name: tensorflow-patterns
plugins.description: TensorFlow and Keras: model building, tf.data pipelines, custom layers, SavedModel export, TFLite quantization, and TFX.

plugins.name: vector-databases
plugins.description: Vector databases: index selection and tuning, pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, multi-tenancy, and reindexing after embedding changes.
